description: Search tenders already matched to the signed-in TenderLead account. Returns tier, data_notice, count and opportunities with contract_id, source links, dates and any available assessment. Follow pagination.next_cursor with the same filters until has_more is false. Stable order is BID first, then score, then notice ID. Counts cover the complete filtered snapshot of stored account matches without known expired deadlines, including older assessments, not the public corpus. Unknown deadline, published value or delivery region is excluded when its filter is used. Value ranges require currency and source-published net/gross basis; no VAT inference. Empty opportunities means no matched results for these filters. Does not search or modify another customer's data.

currency.description: Published ISO currency, such as GBP. Required with a value range.

cursor.description: Next cursor from this search. Repeat the same filters on every page.

deadline_from.description: Inclusive deadline lower bound with explicit UTC offset.

deadline_to.description: Inclusive deadline upper bound with explicit UTC offset. Unknown deadlines do not match deadline filters.

delivery_regions.description: Match any exact source delivery-region label or code, ignoring case. Unknown regions are excluded; buyer location is not delivery geography.

limit.description: Page size from 1 to 20, default 10. Repeat it on continuation pages or omit to reuse it.

query.description: Words from the tender title or buyer name; not delivery geography.

recommendation.description: Saved TenderLead recommendation, not a user bid decision.

value_basis.description: Source-published VAT basis. Required with a value range; no inferred VAT conversion.

name: search_tenders

count.description: Number of opportunities returned in this response.

complete_snapshot.description: The underlying snapshot contains every stored match satisfying the filters. Each response is only one page; follow has_more and next_cursor.

data_notice.description: Safety notice for untrusted external text.

opportunities.description: Matched notices available to this account; an empty array is a valid result.

contract_id.description: TenderLead notice identifier; use for get_tender_decision or save_tender.

deadline.description: Notice deadline when available; check the original notice for changes.

estimated_value.description: Stored normalised estimate; it may include an inferred VAT adjustment. Prefer published_value for source amounts and VAT basis.

published_value.description: Source-published amounts only; no inferred VAT conversion. Null, unstated basis or conflict requires checking the notice before monetary totals.

recommendation.description: Saved BID or SKIP recommendation, not submission approval.

score.description: Available fit assessment from 0 to 100; null or absent means no usable score.

source_url.description: Link to the original public notice; verify submission requirements there.

tier.description: Effective account access tier for this read.

title: Search matched tenders
